scientific_integrity: The originating one-particle process and general environmental conditional-independence mechanism are prior work; the claimed extension is the separate-reset pair moment and exponent-universal correlation. Analytic arguments and 49 reproducibility checks provided. Independent assessment not performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent conditional Cox resets at a common stationary Poisson-refreshed hazard, fixed positive diffusion; near-zero rate density exponent strictly between -1 and 1; stationary-then-slow-refresh order of limits; no claim for simultaneous resets or entire joint-position distribution.
title: Universal correlations from separately resetting Brownian particles in a common fluctuating environment
